probes.check: am_probe_enkits_diagnostics(): the scheduler's configuration has the facade's thread-start callback, and enkiTS's task threads reported to the facade.

seeded_violation.description: Remove the threadStart assignment from am_bind_enkits_diagnostics().

adaptation_notes: enkiTS has no log or runtime assert hook; its profiler callbacks report task threads starting and stopping, which the glue logs at trace level, and threads suspending or waiting, which the glue profiles as facade zones.
ENKI_ASSERT is a compile-time macro; define it before including TaskScheduler.h to route enkiTS's asserts, which no probe checks.
